[P2] Fence operation settlement as well as admission

This check only guards entry. A replayed successful step awaiting an asynchronous `serdes.deserialize` bypasses `runInvocationCallback`. After the deadline rejects the wrapper, releasing that deserializer still fulfills the `DurablePromise`, resuming handler code and `finally` blocks in the expired invocation. Guard fulfillment and rejection of admitted operation promises after closure while preserving eager operation startup. Add a regression that holds a replay deserializer past expiry and verifies that the original handler never resumes.
